title: anogramma ascensionis
intro: Anogramma ascensionis, commonly known as the Mountain Club Moss, is a non-vascular plant species that belongs to the family Anogrammitaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, and its health benefits include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Anogramma ascensionis include its potential to act as an anti-arthritic agent and to exhibit antispasmodic and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
